<a id="update_weapons"></a>
### [`update_weapons`](../../../../src/plane/weapons.asm#L6) `$6382`

*routine*

Updates the bomb and the bullet each frame: starts, moves and ends them. Bomb damage and gun damage jam the release at random.
$40ba = bomb damage.
